v25_observation.interpretation: Read-copy wall is about half host service in this observation. CPU endpoint association is not residency or a universal rate. Dispatch compares submitter/worker contexts, not necessarily one thread migration.

single_variable: Only the shared payload allocation/coherency ownership changes: standard dma_alloc_noncoherent (dma_alloc_pages wrapper) plus explicit full-allocation synchronization. Descriptor memory remains dma_alloc_coherent.

allocation.initial_owner: CPU: dma_direct_alloc_pages returns page_address and zeroes it without handing it to device
allocation.mapping: Expected cacheable normal linear mapping on this fixed ARM64 direct-DMA noncoherent device, from Linux API/source; no fake dma-coherent DT flag, PTE changes, cache alias or raw physical handle
allocation.identity: mmc_dev(mmc) expands to mmc->parent, identical to &pdev->dev passed to mmc_alloc_host and allocation

ownership: Initial payload_device_owned=false; command entry rejects dma_dead or device-owned payload before tuning poison or any CPU payload access.
Original command validation/128-or512 fresh poison remain before dma_start. Pre-start stop retains all three physical reset fences; any failure sets dma_dead and quarantines both allocations.
While CPU-owned, fill write payload; a short SG copy fails before any device handoff. All threshold/descriptor errors remain before handoff.

dma_sync_single_for_device with identical device, DMA handle, full65536 size and DMA_BIDIRECTIONAL; set device-owned flag; preserve existing dma_wmb and all hardware activation writes. No fallible return remains after successful handoff before command wait/mandatory stop.

After successful controller DMA reset, DMAC reset and FIFO reset, clear old DMA status then sync_single_for_cpu(BIDIRECTIONAL,full65536) when device-owned; only then clear ownership. Same central stop covers normal success, command errors, tuning, cleanup and remove.
Any reset timeout bypasses sync_cpu, payload access, copying and freeing. Existing dma_dead and ios_error, both-buffer quarantine, and future command/clock guards remain.

Free payload with dma_free_noncoherent and exact allocation device/address/size/direction, only probe early failure before hardware exposure or remove after successful stop; descriptors use original coherent free.
full_allocation_reason: Shared bidirectional payload also receives CPU-written read-side poison. Full64KiB maintenance handles dirty allocation tails and short128/512/4B ranges without partial-cacheline assumptions. No separate mapping/unmapping or DMA direction changes per request.
preserved: all original hardware MMIO, sleep/poll/reset ordering and arguments
both mandatory reset fences and quarantine
128/512 tuning validation, fresh poison and ordinary payload compare flow
default-off v25 diagnostic instrumentation call sites and counter schema
measurement_semantics: dma_start now includes sync_for_device; pre_reset includes sync_cpu only if ownership outstanding
post_reset includes added sync_for_cpu after successful physical fences; do not call its entire duration pure reset cost
worker_service includes all changes, max and CPU endpoint limits unchanged
dispatch endpoint differences compare submission and worker contexts, not proof of same-thread migration
